value.name: Asha listens to Marcus breathing
value.description: Asha keeps the phone on her thigh and listens to Marcus's uneven breathing without trying to interpret or interrupt it.
evidence: He's answering. Stay in the silence.

she listened to Marcus breathing on the line, in and out, a small uneven sound she had not heard in ten years, and she did not try to name what it meant or to help him toward whatever he was about to say.

value.name: Asha holds her father's hand more firmly
value.description: Asha tightens her grip on her father's palm and notices his hand warming in hers after years of not holding it.
evidence: Asha closed her fingers a fraction more around her father's palm
his hand was warmer now than when she had first taken it.

value.name: Asha stops counting breaths
value.description: As Marcus's breathing continues beside her father's, Asha stops counting breaths and simply waits while holding her father's hand.
evidence: she was no longer counting—not her father's breaths, not Marcus's, not the seconds—only holding the hand she had spent ten years not holding and waiting for whichever brother spoke first.

value.name: Asha asks Marcus which rate sheet option works
value.description: Asha pulls the rate sheet closer and asks Marcus which of the closer-place options he wants.
evidence: Asha didn't let go of her father's hand.
She kept her fingers folded over his palm
"The rates for the closer place are here, Marcus," she said, low enough not to disturb the slow rise and fall under the blanket. "Which one works?"

value.name: Marcus remains silent on the line
value.description: After Asha's question, the call stays open without an immediate response from Marcus.
